name: Garry's Mod
hint: Physics sandbox server in Steam peer-to-peer mode, joined by its p2p address

SERVER_NAME.title: Server name
SERVER_NAME.description: Players join through Steam's peer-to-peer relay: open the developer console and run the "connect p2p:..." line the server prints in the app's logs at startup. Without a login token that address changes on every restart.

SERVER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Leave empty for an open server; players otherwise run password <value> before connect.

GSLT.title: Game Server Login Token
GSLT.description: Optional, from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers with App ID 4000. Keeps the p2p address the same across restarts.
